name: memory
description: Short- and long-term memory across sessions.

commands.name: memorize
commands.template: Store the following as a durable memory and confirm what you kept: {input}

commands.name: recall
commands.description: Recall a stored fact with its date
commands.template: Recall what you know about: {input}. Quote the stored entry and its date; say when nothing is stored.

commands.name: forget
commands.template: Delete the memory about: {input}. List exactly what will be removed, ask for confirmation, then report what was deleted.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Writes to persistent memory that survives across sessions. Two tiers: 'user' = the user profile (name, expertise, language, style, topics, projects); 'memory' = the fact collection (environment facts, conventions, lessons). Keep entries compact and high-signal. On the 'memory' tier 'replace' supersedes the identified fact instead of forgetting it (the old fact stays askable as history), and 'memory_type' classifies the fact kind.

content.description: Entry text (add/replace). For target=user use 'field=value', e.g. 'name=Test User'.

memory_type.description: Fact kind for target=memory: semantic=state of things, episodic=something that happened, procedural=how to do it.

supersedes.description: Entry id that this write corrects (target=memory, action=replace). Optional; 'old_text' identifies it otherwise.
